nodes.description: SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (uint c) with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (uint c) with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (uint c) with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (uint c) with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner, stages pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership() public, requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalizes ownership and zeroes newOwner.
InGRedientToken() constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, minted _totalSupply for owner and emits Transfer.
totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits msg.sender via SafeMath.sub and credits to via SafeMath.add, emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then performs external receiveApproval callback on spender.
Anonymous payable fallback function that always reverts; contract rejects ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner, invokes external ERC20 transfer to owner.
farmerRequestCertificate(address _certAuth, uint _tokens, ...) sets allowed[owner][_certAuth] = _tokens with no ownership check.
certAuthIssuesCerticate(address owner, address farmer, uint tokens, ...) moves balances of caller-supplied owner to farmer and zeroes allowance.
sellsIngrWithoutDepletion(address to, uint tokens, string _url) performs a plain balance transfer from msg.sender to to.
sellsIntermediateGoodWithDepletion(address to, uint tokens, string _url, uint out2inIngredientPercentage) computes tokens*percentage/100 with unchecked raw arithmetic.
genAddressFromGTIN13date(string _GTIN13, string _YYMMDD) constant derives an address from keccak256 of the two strings.
transferAndWriteUrl(address to, uint tokens, string _url) transfers balances from msg.sender and records the url in calldata.

comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred(address _to, uint _numSKUsSold, string _url, uint _qttyIGRinLLSKU, string _GTIN13, string _YYMMDD) computes (_numSKUsSold-1)*_qttyIGRinLLSKU and performs two transfers.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data) external callback entry point implemented by spender contracts.
address public owner; privileged account for onlyOwner functions.
address public newOwner; pending owner during two-step ownership transfer.
string public symbol; token ticker IGR.
string public name; token name InGRedientToken.
uint8 public decimals; token decimals used to compute total supply.
uint public _totalSupply; fixed token supply set in constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances; per-account token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller identity used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after allowance update.
Unchecked raw arithmetic tokens*out2inIngredientPercentage/100 before SafeMath-protected transfer.
Unchecked raw arithmetic (_numSKUsSold-1)*_qttyIGRinLLSKU with potential underflow/overflow.
Missing access control on farmerRequestCertificate: any caller can overwrite allowed[owner][_certAuth].
Missing access control on certAuthIssuesCerticate: caller-supplied owner balance can be drained to an arbitrary farmer.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, unvalidated token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender balance is debited and msg.sender is emitted as Transfer sender.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when subtracting allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
Any msg.sender can invoke farmerRequestCertificate and set allowed[owner][_certAuth] without being the owner.
msg.sender is used as allowance spender and can zero allowed[owner][msg.sender] for any owner argument.
msg.sender balance is debited in sellsIngrWithoutDepletion.
msg.sender balance is debited in transferAndWriteUrl.
comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred debits msg.sender indirectly through transferAndWriteUrl.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender against newOwner to authorize the ownership transfer.
Owned constructor initializes owner from msg.sender.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner and clears newOwner under the require(msg.sender == newOwner) guard.
newOwner is read and then reset to address(0) in acceptOwnership.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender == owner.
farmerRequestCertificate overwrites the allowance of the owner state variable with no ownership check.
allowed mapping is written in approve.
allowed mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
allowed mapping is read in allowance.
allowed[owner][_certAuth] is set to _tokens by an unprivileged caller.
allowed[owner][msg.sender] is force-zeroed inside certAuthIssuesCerticate.
balances mapping is read in balanceOf.
balances of sender and recipient are updated in transfer.
balances of from and to are updated in transferFrom.
balances of the caller-supplied owner parameter are debited and farmer is credited without authorization.
balances[address(0)] is read in totalSupply.
_totalSupply is read in totalSupply.
_totalSupply is assigned the fixed supply in the constructor.
balances[owner] is initialized with the whole supply in the constructor.
decimals is used to scale the minted supply in the constructor.
approveAndCall performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval after mutating the allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to an arbitrary external token contract via transfer.
tokens*out2inIngredientPercentage/100 is raw unchecked multiplication that can overflow before being passed to transfer.
(_numSKUsSold-1)*_qttyIGRinLLSKU is raw unchecked arithmetic that can underflow or overflow.
No onlyOwner/require check protects the allowance write performed by farmerRequestCertificate.
No caller authorization protects certAuthIssuesCerticate from draining an arbitrary owner balance.
genAddressFromGTIN13date is invoked from comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred to derive the destination address.
transferAndWriteUrl is invoked twice from comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier evaluated against msg.sender.
transferOwnership only stages newOwner when msg.sender equals owner.
sellsIntermediateGoodWithDepletion routes msg.sender funds through the internal transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token can only be reached when msg.sender satisfies the onlyOwner check.
